context: Diagnostic run overlaps the local full rendering contract suite; use spans to locate work, not for isolated timing or retention comparisons.
methodology: Real advertisement app and UI switch buttons, built library, fresh Chromium profile per trial. Current eager compatibility API versus owned API; not a historical executable. Loopback network/module/font startup included. Owned-store counters observe only advertisement themes (eager results are not bound to that registry), not mount-cycle owners. Blob counters are global to the page. Two frame boundaries and one task precede consistent post-GC sampling. Post-GC CDP heap/backing-storage and sum of browser-process RSS are recorded separately from asset counters. Twenty public mount/disconnect cycles follow app teardown. Telemetry and hooks exist only in this local server. Diagnostic run adds phase wrappers and long-task/resource observers. Phase durations overlap and must not be summed; retheme includes load. Retained trace arrays and resource buffers make its heap figures incomparable with normal-mode results. Long tasks cover the main thread only. This run is recorded separately.
